Why are overtime pay and bonuses included in Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) assessment?
reference_answer: Basic salary, overtime pay, and bonuses are part of a worker’s total income that will help support the worker and his or her family. Given that the Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) is intended to supplement the income of lower-wage workers, it is most useful to assess the total income in determining one’s eligibility for WIS.

query: What category of expenses are non-subsidised bills pro-rated for under the Medishield program?
